rows.text: In the address headed 総裁挨拶 森喜朗総裁, which he gives as party president (党総裁としてご挨拶を申し述べさせていただきます), 森 names as the second task for renewing the party bringing forward the presidential election planned for this autumn (本年秋に予定されている総裁選挙を…繰り上げて実施すること), with the timing and method to be agreed later.
